definitions.rpm: Chat-completion HTTP attempts dispatched in (t-60s,t], including failures; model-discovery GETs excluded
definitions.tpm: Known provider prompt+completion usage attributed to dispatch or completion, separately; nonstreaming, not per-token timestamps or account limits
definitions.cache: Sum cache-hit input tokens / sum input tokens for responses reporting cache usage
definitions.reasoning: Reported as a subset of completion tokens; never added to billed output twice
definitions.costs: Tariff estimate uses the dispatch window; budget enforcement charges all input at peak miss prices and retains unknown reservations
definitions.resources: Sampled Docker stats exclude some page cache; raw cgroup peaks, OOM events, host memory and disk observations are preserved separately
definitions.tool_calls: Names proposed in real provider responses, not proof of successful local execution; inspect application trace for execution outcomes
